tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to learn Paperplane’s promise: document inputs become grounded Markdown and structured JSON with evidence rather than unsupported guesses. It also frames the processing modes and operational expectations that the remaining steps implement.

tour.title: FastAPI Runtime
tour.description: The backend entry point assembles the FastAPI application, lifecycle services, middleware, routers, and health endpoints. Read it with configuration and parser setup to see how a request reaches the stateless processing runtime.
tour.languageLesson: FastAPI composes an application from routers and dependency-aware services; async startup and shutdown hooks centralize lifecycle work.

tour.title: Grounded Data Contracts
tour.description: These contracts define the vocabulary shared by the parsing pipeline: source documents, pages, chunks, evidence, verification states, and final results. They are high fan-in modules, so understanding them makes later services and API responses easier to follow.
tour.languageLesson: Python dataclasses and typed validation models make cross-layer document state explicit instead of relying on unstructured dictionaries.

tour.title: Document Processing Pipeline
tour.description: Ingestion validates input and renders pages, while the V2 pipeline drafts, grounds, reconciles, and verifies page content. This is the core path that turns visual documents into auditable output governed by the contracts from the previous step.

tour.title: HTTP API Surface
tour.description: FastAPI routers expose document processing, review, and extraction-schema workflows to clients. These modules translate HTTP requests into the service calls and persisted job state explained in the preceding steps.

tour.title: Evidence Studio Frontend
tour.description: The Next.js workspace starts parse jobs, polls their progress, and presents the resulting document canvas and artifacts. Its small API client keeps browser interactions aligned with the backend routes without duplicating parsing logic.
tour.languageLesson: Next.js App Router files define route behavior by location, while client components coordinate interactive state and typed fetch calls.

tour.title: Quality and Evaluation
tour.description: Tests exercise the worker’s durable assembly path and the pipeline’s evidence and verification behavior. Use them as executable examples of the failure cases and guarantees the runtime is expected to preserve.

tour.title: Architecture Documentation
tour.description: The architecture guide explains the production topology and durable page-processing flow in prose, while the interactive diagram provides a visual map. Together they connect the implementation layers to the system-level design.

tour.title: Delivery and CI
tour.description: Docker packages the backend, and the CI workflow validates changes before release. This final stop shows how the application is run and checked outside the developer workstation.
tour.languageLesson: Container builds isolate runtime dependencies, while Compose and CI describe repeatable multi-service execution and automated verification.
